title: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Pawns

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A former planeswalker and artificer from Kaladesh, stranded on Ixalan, who builds filigree quetzacama for the Sun Empire, is Huatli's lover, and transcribes the secret meeting at Sen Gael.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: The Sun Empire's warrior-poet, a former planeswalker who lost her spark, who joins Caztaca's plot against Atlacan and goes on an expedition below Orazca.

entities.name: Pantlaza
entities.description: Huatli's new quetzacama companion, a promising young raptor.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli IV
entities.description: The child emperor of the Sun Empire, who clutches a stuffed quetzacama and is manipulated by his uncle and aunt.

entities.name: Atlacan Huicintli
entities.description: The boy-emperor's uncle and majordomo, who craves the throne, pushes for war on Torrezon, and pressures Saheeli and Huatli.

entities.name: Caztaca Huicintli
entities.description: The apex priestess of the Threefold Sun and the late emperor's eldest daughter, who leads a conspiracy to depose Atlacan and avert war.

entities.name: Chitlati
entities.description: Huatli's aide and attaché who accompanies Saheeli as interpreter.

entities.name: Caparocti Sunborn
entities.description: A Sun Empire officer whose lancers Huatli is ordered to accompany.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: A living saint of the Church of Dusk with a glowing halo, who meets Caztaca and Brass at Sen Gael to prevent war and Aclazotz's return.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: The admiral and governor of the Brazen Coalition, who bursts in to demand recognition for her coalition as a nation.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: A hierophant of the Antifex leading an unsanctioned second expedition to Orazca.

entities.name: Antifex
entities.description: A figure whose hierophants include Vito.

entities.name: Pontifex Fein
entities.description: The leader who struggles to hold the Church of Dusk together.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A planeswalker student of history from Arcavios whom Saheeli has summoned to aid her.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The vampire god whom fanatics hope to return to Alta Torrezon.

entities.name: Threefold Sun
entities.description: The Sun Empire's divine triad served by Caztaca.

entities.name: Tilonalli
entities.description: A Sun Empire deity whose light shines on all.

entities.name: Kinjalli
entities.description: A Sun Empire deity whose word the emperor's is said to be.

entities.name: Ixalli
entities.description: A Sun Empire deity whose will the emperor's is said to be.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where Saheeli is stranded.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city where the emperor holds court and where new chambers have been found below.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: The Sun Empire's capital.

entities.name: Otepec
entities.description: A city of temples to the Threefold Sun destroyed in the Phyrexian war.

entities.name: Tocatli
entities.description: The Imperial citadel above Pachatupa where Caztaca resides.

entities.name: Queen's Bay
entities.description: A port where the second Dawn Fleet is being built.

entities.name: Sen Gael
entities.description: The main island of the Sens, home islands of the orcs, where the secret meeting takes place in a lighthouse cabin.

entities.name: Alta Torrezon
entities.description: The land of the vampires on the continent of Torrezon.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Saheeli's home plane, remembered for its revolt.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: A city on Kaladesh whose Consulate Saheeli says she contacted.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane that the last Omenpath opened to.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: A college on Arcavios from which Saheeli says she requested aid.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire Saheeli now serves.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A pirate fleet nation led by Admiral Brass.

entities.name: Church of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire church facing schism.

entities.name: Dusk Legion
entities.description: The vampires' military arm and the Sun Empire's enemy.

entities.name: Canchatan
entities.description: Temple guards chosen for faith, loyalty and prowess who serve Caztaca.

entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: One of the queen's ventures, infiltrated by fanatics.

entities.name: Dawn Fleet
entities.description: The Sun Empire's fleet, a second and larger one being built at Queen's Bay.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders whose war and assassination of the emperor shaped the present.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact whose departure ended the crown's interest in Ixalan.

entities.name: Filigree quetzacama
entities.description: Saheeli's mechanical quetzacama being built for the emperor.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: A portal in the Multiverse that brought Saheeli to Ixalan and closed behind her.

entities.name: Spark
entities.description: The planeswalking ability that Saheeli and Huatli lost.

entities.name: Multiverse
entities.description: The collection of planes that Saheeli and Huatli can no longer reach.

events.summary: Saheeli stands alone on a beach on Ixalan's northern coast, mourning the loss of planeswalking.
events.quote: Saheeli stood on the white sand of some lonely strand of Ixalan's northern coast.

events.summary: Saheeli tries to planeswalk and finds nothing.
events.quote: She tried. Nothing.

events.summary: Huatli trains playfully with her new quetzacama companion Pantlaza in the surf.
events.quote: She turned to see Huatli and Pantlaza

events.summary: Huatli shares her own grief at the loss of her spark.
events.quote: With my spark, I felt whole

events.summary: Saheeli theorizes their sparks were moved, not destroyed.
events.quote: Our sparks were moved. Not destroyed

events.summary: Huatli proposes they explore Ixalan together the slow way.
events.quote: We can go together, the slow way, and find out.

events.summary: Huatli and Saheeli attend the boy-emperor's court at Orazca during his post-invasion tour.
events.quote: The boy-emperor, Apatzec Intli IV, had traveled here with a great retinue as part of his post-invasion, post-coronation tour of the lands under his dominion.

events.summary: Saheeli reviews the background: the previous emperor was killed by a Phyrexian assassin and his young son took the throne.
events.quote: the previous emperor had not planned to die at the hands of a Phyrexian assassin

events.summary: The court's factions are laid out, with Atlacan opposed by Caztaca for control of the boy-emperor.
events.quote: Opposing Atlacan was Caztaca Huicintli, the apex priest of the Threefold Sun and eldest daughter of the late emperor.

events.summary: Saheeli explains she produces about a dozen filigree quetzacama a day and describes the talent bottleneck.
events.quote: We produce around a dozen of my filigree quetzacama daily

events.summary: Saheeli announces a six to eight month delay in the order.
events.quote: I anticipate a delay of six to eight months.

events.summary: Atlacan threatens consequences if the mechanoquetzacama are not delivered on time.
events.quote: You will have the emperor's mechanoquetzacama complete in the time first promised, or there will be consequences

events.summary: Atlacan orders Huatli to explore newly found chambers below Orazca with Caparocti's lancers.
events.quote: you will accompany Caparocti Sunborn and his lancers on this journey and serve as the eyes of the empire.

events.summary: In the market Huatli tells Saheeli that Atlacan wants to resume his father's war on Torrezon.
events.quote: Atlacan wants to resume his father's war

events.summary: Huatli says Atlacan is already building a second Dawn Fleet at Queen's Bay.
events.quote: He is already building a second Dawn Fleet in Queen's Bay, larger and mightier than the first.

events.summary: Huatli explains that without her spark she cannot resist openly.
events.quote: Without my spark I cannot escape the consequences of resistance.

events.summary: Saheeli reveals she requested aid through an Omenpath, and that a planeswalker student named Quintorius Kand is coming.
events.quote: The last Omenpath that appeared opened only to Arcavios; I immediately sent a request for aid, and they said they would send a student of history.

events.summary: Huatli reveals a planned coup to depose Atlacan and place Caztaca beside the emperor.
events.quote: The meeting is to plan how to depose Atlacan, defang the emperor's guard, and move Caztaca to power at the emperor's side.

events.summary: Huatli asks Saheeli to speak with her voice at the meeting and introduces Chitlati.
events.quote: At this meeting, you speak with my voice.

events.summary: Huatli's allies smuggle Saheeli out of Orazca to the coast.
events.quote: The small group of co-conspirators secreted Saheeli out from the golden city to the coast

events.summary: Saheeli sails seasick for nearly a week on a Brazen Coalition ship.
events.quote: The journey from Queen's Bay across the eastern ocean took nearly a week.

events.summary: Caztaca approaches Saheeli aboard the ship.
events.quote: Apex Priestess Caztaca Huicintli, eldest daughter of the late emperor and beloved aunt to the new emperor, waved her hand, dismissing Chitlati and the bowing sailors.

events.summary: Caztaca questions Saheeli about her quetzacama and learns they obey whoever holds their command codes.
events.quote: They're loyal to whomever holds their command codes.

events.summary: Caztaca distinguishes Alta Torrezon, the land of vampires, from the continent of Torrezon.
events.quote: Alta Torrezon is the land of vampires.

events.summary: Caztaca asks Saheeli to take notes in her own script.
events.quote: Take notes in your language

events.summary: Saheeli waits on the cold Sen Gael beach for the secret meeting to begin.
events.quote: Saheeli stood on a dark, cold beach on the eastern coast of Sen Gael, the main island of the Sens

events.summary: Saheeli recalls how unrest and doomsday cults are splitting the Church of Dusk and Alta Torrezon.
events.quote: Doomsday fervor spread across Alta Torrezon like a plague of eager fear.

events.summary: Caztaca tells Saheeli that trust will be forged by shared betrayal.
events.quote: will be forged tonight by shared betrayal

events.summary: A guard reports that Elenda herself is among the arriving party.
events.quote: Elenda is with them.

events.summary: Saint Elenda enters, glowing with a halo, and sits with Caztaca.
events.quote: The Venerable swept her hood back as she entered the cabin, uncovering her face and revealing a soft, steadily glowing diadem that crowned her head.

events.summary: Caztaca lays out her concern that the emperor will lead the Sun Empire into another war.
events.quote: Our emperor will lead us to war

events.summary: Elenda tells of schism in the Church of Dusk and a second expedition to Orazca.
events.quote: Pontifex Fein struggles to hold the Church of Dusk together.

events.summary: Elenda reveals the second expedition is led by Vito, a hierophant of the Antifex, and could bring Aclazotz to Alta Torrezon.
events.quote: This group is led by Vito Quijano de Pasamonte, one of the Antifex's hierophants

events.summary: Elenda warns that if Aclazotz sets claw on Torrezon the realm will tear itself apart.
events.quote: If Aclazotz sets one claw on Torrezon, the realm will tear itself apart

events.summary: Admiral Beckett Brass bursts in with armed pirates and takes control of the meeting.
events.quote: You came here on my ship, to haggle over nations on my island

events.summary: Brass demands that her coalition be recognized as a player on equal terms.
events.quote: my coalition demands recognition as a player of this game on equal terms.

events.summary: Brass threatens to kill both leaders and blockade the seas if refused.
events.quote: Then I'll kill the two of you here and the stink of cannon smoke will choke Torrezon and Ixalan

events.summary: Saheeli urges the leaders to accept Brass's demand.
events.quote: Accept her demand

events.summary: Caztaca recounts the coalition's past raids on the Sun Empire's coast.
events.quote: They raided our fishing fleets and pillaged our temples

events.summary: Caztaca reveals the emperor is building a fleet of ten thousand ships to invade Alta Torrezon.
events.quote: The emperor is building another fleet of ten thousand ships

events.summary: Brass states the coalition's naval strength.
events.quote: We have six hundred fighting ships stocked and seaworthy, all veteran crews

events.summary: Elenda promises letters of marque and recognition of the coalition if Brass stops Vito's expedition.
events.quote: We will write you letters of marque

events.summary: Caztaca asks the coalition to burn the second Dawn Fleet and draw the army away from the capital.
events.quote: Burn those ships in their docks.

events.summary: Caztaca gives Brass a feather, to be returned when Caztaca rules in Pachatupa in exchange for a nation.
events.quote: Return this to me when I rule in Pachatupa, and I will give you your nation.

events.summary: The three leaders sign the contract Saheeli transcribed.
events.quote: One by one the three leaders signed, sealing their contract.

events.summary: Saheeli seals the document in a metal cylinder that only she can open.
events.quote: Saheeli spun a fine, copper, silver, and gold container around the document.

events.summary: Brass and Elenda depart, each toasting a new world.
events.quote: Pleasure doing business with you two.

events.summary: Caztaca says she needs swords and the warrior-poet, not admiration.
events.quote: I need action. I need swords. I need the warrior-poet.

events.summary: Saheeli pledges that she and Huatli will be with Caztaca.
events.quote: Huatli and I will be with you

events.summary: Caztaca and Saheeli shake hands and leave for the ship back to Ixalan.
events.quote: toward the distant ship that would bear them back to Ixalan

relations.quote: She kissed Huatli, then pushed her ahead.
the boy-emperor's uncle and posthumously legitimized paper son of the late emperor
beloved aunt to the new emperor
My brother Atlacan craves the throne but can never have it

relations.note: rival for influence over the boy-emperor

relations.quote: The meeting is to plan how to depose Atlacan
the mug of water Huatli's attaché offered her
I am the warrior-poet. I serve the empire.

relations.note: now a subject, no longer a guest
relations.quote: she was a subject of the empire now, no longer a guest

relations.note: builds them daily for the emperor
relations.quote: We produce around a dozen of my filigree quetzacama daily
Admiral Beckett Brass, leader of the Brazen Coalition.

relations.note: makes a deal to back the coup
agree to be friends and collaborators
relations.quote: After tonight, the only friends we have will be the people in this room.
